title: Blind narrow-kerf bucket-ladder digger with screw-metered wedge pour
problem_restatement: Move whole mass over loose soil, break bed, lift flow to storage, hold carried mass, pour to bin, and do it blind from sensor signals.
mechanism_sentence: Four grouser wheels carry a frame that cuts a 100 mm wide slot 50 mm deep, lifts the spoil with a bucket chain into a steep hopper, then tilts and screws 15 kg loads over the bin while onboard cameras guide blind driving.
decisive_choices: Chose four-wheel grouser skid-steer C9 over tank tracks C8 because tracks clog and slip while 294 N traction vs 11 N cut with 15.6 kPa float fits box.
Chose narrow-kerf chain C36 over full-width ladder C1 and scraper C3 and drum C31 because 11 N draft vs 32.9 N full width vs 294 N traction fits 16.4 W power and feeds ladder.

Chose auger live-bottom with rear tilt C37 over plain tilting hopper plus vibrator C5 because screw meters 15 kg pour with 0.55 m pivot clearing 0.40 m lip by 0.15 m holding 1.69 level-only tip factor.
open_question: Will the 20 L steep wedge hopper with 150 mm outlet and screw reliably discharge without arching?
transfer_line: Load: narrow kerf trenching chain -> inclined bucket ladder -> steep wedge hopper | Measured: downward dig camera -> sealed station operator

assumed_constraints.constraint: working stress capped near 15 ksi for 6061-T6 aluminium tube
trips limited to 15 kg and dump only on level ground

concept.working_principle: Front narrow chain cuts a shallow slot and leaves side spoil, wide bucket ladder lifts spoil and drops over top sprocket into steep wedge hopper, rear tilt plus floor screw meters pour over bin lip while cameras plus heartbeat stop plus fiducial reset operate blind.

fabrication_steps.description: Weld twin-tube aluminium frame first because wheels, digger and hopper bolt to it
fabrication_steps.method: TIG-welded 6061-T6 tube, 25.4 mm square x 3 mm wall

fabrication_steps.description: Bolt folding arms and grouser wheels to frame because track width sets stow and stability
fabrication_steps.method: bolted aluminium arms, 200 mm wheels with 10 mm grousers

fabrication_steps.description: Mount kerf chain and bucket ladder with chute to frame because cut must align to lift
fabrication_steps.method: bolted steel chain, 100 mm wide kerf 50 mm deep

fabrication_steps.description: Install wedge hopper with screw and rear pivot plus battery and cameras because pour and power complete system
fabrication_steps.method: bolted smooth steel hopper, 20 L 150 mm outlet 0.55 m pivot; 24 V 20 Ah pack

risks.risk: BP-1 arches in wedge hopper and blocks pour
risks.mitigation: Run half-full 15 kg trips with screw metering and keep arching as bench test
Dump only on level ground gated by tilt sensor at 15 kg trips

risks.risk: Link loss and drift cause overshoot and misalignment
risks.mitigation: Cap speed and halt on 0.5 s heartbeat loss plus fiducial reset every 5 m

novelty_claim: Narrow 100 mm kerf slot feeding wide bucket ladder to steep wedge hopper with screw-metered rear tilt for blind pour.

figure_spec.system_view: side view bucket ladder feeding wedge hopper with rear tilt over bin on grouser wheels with cameras

open_questions: Does wedge hopper with 150 mm outlet arch with BP-1 and need bench test?
